description: Banking Backend refers to the server on which the India Banking server module (india_banking_connector) is installed. A bank-specific connector for the backend instance, registered with the specified bank, can be defined using this connector.

fields.description: The base URL of the backend server that has a Frappe instance with the india_banking_connector app installed and is registered with the bank. This should include the port number if the backend server is configured to run on a non-standard port other than 80 and 443.
fields.label: Backend Base URL

fields.description: The API key of the user or service account that is created on the backend Frappe instance and is used to interact with it. This can be created in the user settings on the backend Frappe instance.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: The API secret of the user or service account that is created on the backend Frappe instance and is used to interact with it. This can be created in the user settings on the backend Frappe instance along with the API key.
fields.label: API Secret

fields.description: Check this option if bulk transactions should be made through this connector via the selected bank.
fields.label: Bulk Transaction
Enqueue large payments in the background

fields.description: Minimum delay between consecutive payment calls to the bank. eg: 10.
fields.label: Payment Call Interval (Seconds)

fields.description: If the number of payments exceeds this limit, they will be queued and processed in the background.
fields.label: Enqueue Payments Threshold

fields.description: Select this option if both the frontend and backend apps of India Banking for the selected bank are on the same server.
fields.label: Is Backend Same As Frontend

name: Banking Backend Connector
